why: Two 2025 papers (Guo–Liu on torsors over valuation rings; Stavrova on the generalized Bass–Quillen conjecture in dimension 2 for reductive group torsors) address generalizations of the conjecture to torsors/G-bundles rather than the classical statement about vector bundles over regular Noetherian rings vs. polynomial extensions; unclear whether either implies a case of the classical conjecture as stated by Wikipedia or is purely a separate analogue.

found.title: The Bass–Quillen conjecture for torsors over valuation rings
found.note: Preprint (published IMRN 2025) proving a torsor-descent result for reductive group schemes over valuation rings, a generalization of the classical vector-bundle conjecture; not read.

found.title: On the generalized Bass–Quillen conjecture in dimension 2
found.note: Preprint proving a dimension-2 case for G-torsors (reductive group schemes), generalizing Murthy's classical dimension-2 result; not read.
